user.title: Set up Battery Lifetime
user.description:
**⚠ HEADS UP — INITIAL SETUP CAN TAKE SEVERAL MINUTES.**

Battery Lifetime auto-discovers every numeric percent battery sensor in Home Assistant and creates around eight companion entities per battery (replace-by, drain rate, profile, threshold, etc.).

**IF YOU HAVE MANY BATTERY-POWERED DEVICES — SAY 50+ BATTERIES, WHICH MEANS 400+ NEW ENTITIES — THE UI WILL APPEAR FROZEN FOR SEVERAL MINUTES AFTER YOU PRESS SUBMIT** while the entities are registered and the one-time cold-start backfill from long-term statistics runs. **Don't reload, don't cancel — just wait. It is working.**

You can opt out individual batteries from the integration's options afterwards. Press Submit to continue.
